corrections.subject: Orientation scale and gate registration
corrections.prior_assertion: Claimed orientation unit 1.0 rad and angular scale sqrt(g/L) = 3.5018 rad/s were registered physical scales, and evaluated an invented 5% orientation gate (0.05 rad ~= 2.86 deg).
corrections.authoritative_finding: Physical L = 0.8m, U = sqrt(g*L) = 2.8014 m/s, and a generic 5% macro tolerance exist in observation_plan.json, but unit radian orientation scale and sqrt(g/L) angular velocity scale are NOT proven registered. The orientation budget is NULL / unregistered until an actual contract source is found. No retrospectively invented gate can be substituted to obtain qualification.

corrections.subject: Unconstrained simulation time claim from step incidence
corrections.prior_assertion: Claimed the simulation was 99.9166% unconstrained based on 273 DTsMin sub-stepping adjustments out of 327,414 Symplectic half-steps (273 / 327402 ~= 0.08338%).
corrections.authoritative_finding: Unweighted step count incidence cannot be equated with simulation duration fraction, because adaptive time steps dt vary dynamically across the simulation window.

corrections.subject: Step count telemetry
corrections.authoritative_finding: Actual coarse telemetry is 76399 steps, and medium telemetry is 96697 steps (the earlier 41200 / 51500 were initial plan approximations, not actual completed solver run steps).
corrections.exact_source_citation: Coarse and Medium Run.out solver logs; review.json:23

corrections.subject: DualSPHysics rotation matrix and Euler angle sequence
corrections.prior_assertion: Assumed DualSPHysics uses aerospace ZYX Euler convention (R = Rz * Ry * Rx).
corrections.authoritative_finding: DualSPHysics primary source FunctionsMath.h:345-353 defines RotMatrix3x3 which is an XYZ rotation matrix (R = Rx(ang.x) * Ry(ang.y) * Rz(ang.z)), differing from ZYX. Furthermore, JDsPartFloatSave.cpp:166 persists center, linear velocity, and angular velocity, but does NOT persist angles. Official FloatingInfo_Help.out:66-85 states roll on X-axis, pitch on Y-axis (with sign change since v5.0.204), and yaw on Z-axis, with no proven Euler chart sequence. Reconstructing the rigid pose directly from same-UID floating-node positions via Kabsch SVD is the only mathematically proven, coordinate-invariant method to extract the true SO(3) pose trajectory.

corrections.subject: Cross-DP frame pairing
corrections.prior_assertion: Paired native frames across runs by array index.
corrections.authoritative_finding: Cross-DP comparison must pair by continuous physical time using SLERP (Spherical Linear Interpolation) on the Lie group SO(3) and linear interpolation of center position, with endpoint validation across t in [0.0, 12.0s], avoiding saved index pairing and avoiding linear interpolation of Euler angles.
